title: RTPS: Improve InstanceStateDataResponse dissection
description:
Always dissect InstanceStateDataResponse as a builtin type without
requiring the "Enable user data dissection" preference. The builtin
type dissection was gated behind enable_user_data_dissection, which
defaults to false, leaving the serialized data undissected.

Improve formatting of fields within InstanceStateDataResponse and
InstanceUpdateData to be consistent with existing RTPS conventions:

- Display writer_guid and reader_guid using the standard RTPS GUID
  format with dedicated filterable fields, matching the format used
  by InstanceStateRequestData.
- Display KeyHashValue as compact colon-separated hex, consistent
  with PID_KEY_HASH.
- Display RTPSTime_t using rtps_util_add_timestamp_sec_and_fraction,
  consistent with other RTPS timestamps.
- Display SequenceNumber_t as a combined 64-bit value, consistent
  with other RTPS sequence numbers.

Relates to WIRESH-288.

AI-Assisted: yes (GitHub Copilot)
